from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents balance extracted from a single company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the report covers (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    cash_line_item: str | None = Field(description="The label of the cash item in the report (e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'ones')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency symbol or code (e.g., '$', 'USD')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
